title: packet-wow: Add missing fields, reconnect packets,
description:
Fixes a part of #11398.

This PR follows up https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/2935 with additions to the WOW protocol implementation.

This PR adds fields that were previously unidentified or misidentified, as well as adding support for reconnection and non-successful authentication.

It also fixes the server realmlist packet which had incorrect field sizes, orders and extra unknown fields.

The wiki is a useful reference:
https://wowdev.wiki/Packets/Login/Vanilla

While [Ember](https://github.com/EmberEmu/Ember/tree/development/src/login/grunt/server) is the most readable implementation of both server and client packets.

More direct links to wiki and Ember are in the commit messages.

The implementation is far from done, however the changes here makes it far more useful since it won't just die on half of the packets.

This capture includes attempted authentication in with an incorrect account, fully authenticating, a realmlist, reconnection and another realmlist. I will add this to the issue as well.
[wow-auth-realm-reconnect.pcapng](/uploads/af43a6f00373e4ad21133eaa9b7e3184/wow-auth-realm-reconnect.pcapng)

commits_data.title: packet-wow: Add error handling for packets
commits_data.message:
packet-wow: Add error handling for packets

Some packets with the error field do not include any remaining fields if
the error is not SUCCESS (0).
Previously this was not handled.

Wiki reference:
https://wowdev.wiki/Packets/Login/Vanilla#Opcodes_and_Errors

The ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN values have been changed because the pre-commit
script complained.

packet-wow: Add missing fields to Challenge Packets

Wiki for reference
https://wowdev.wiki/Packets/Login/Vanilla#Challenge_packets

Ember has an implementation
https://github.com/EmberEmu/Ember/blob/03c130d3d6276e7032fc9e13c9d287ea7c6ed536/src/login/grunt/server/LoginChallenge.h#L60

The two factor field is not present on versions before 1.12, although
getting a capture of it is difficult because clients before 1.12 are not
used for emulation.
